risk_note: RV2 ledger (B2-16b; BR-INV-24 ⑦⑧, BR-FUND-15, BR-FUND-16). Ledger implements growth's InviteRewardGrantWriter: on the caller's transaction it posts one REWARD:INVITE voucher per side (debit platform MKT_EXPENSE, credit the user's USER_BALANCE available, ledger-templates.csv 252–253) through ledger's existing posting, uniq_key INVITE_REWARD:{invitee_user_id}:{side}; a replay of the same key returns the original voucher_id without posting again; amount 0 posts nothing; input checks (side / beneficiary, amount) throw INVALID_INPUT before any SQL; time from the injected Clock. Growth / app.module wiring (thin adapter for the zero result) is out of this task.
